correctness.rationale: On Q2 the map is affine with matrix A=[[-1,-1],[1,-1]], determinant 2. The six signed constraints for 0,1,2 visits give the exact bounded P_t. Direct rational halfplane clipping at t=1/10,1/3,1/2,3/4,1,3/2,2,3 verified c(t), below-cut area d(t), simultaneous exit area h(t), including switch boundaries. The proof shows A^{-1}(P_t) lies in Q2 throughout t>0, so S_{3+k}=q+alpha A^{-k}P_t for every k; area halves. Constant affine Jacobian maps conditional uniform survivors to the same exit polygon, yielding independence of clock and channel with probabilities 2^-k e_j/c. The finite checks corroborate exact rational branch formulas, not the all-k proof.
